commentary: Market breadth has deteriorated sharply to 40% alongside an 8–11% spike in India VIX, crude topping $102/bbl, and the Nifty dropping 200 points to 23,200. Under Stan Weinstein's stage analysis and William O'Neil's market-direction framework ('M' in CANSLIM), a 'WEAK' deterministic gate confirms an environment under active institutional distribution. In such treacherous conditions, general market headwinds drag down roughly three out of four setups regardless of individual chart patterns. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate aggressive defense: curtail position sizing, hold elevated cash, and demand pristine CANSLIM fundamentals before entertaining Stage 2 breakouts. Until the benchmark prints a verified follow-through day, capital preservation remains paramount.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Tape Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, within 1.5% of the 104.09 pivot with 1.23x volume. However, the advance lacks convincing volume expansion, and the loose base structure exhibits minimal institutional sponsorship amidst broader market liquidation.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue plunged 56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 Cr while net profit fell 25.6% to ₹1.02 Cr. A weak ROCE of ~5.6% and volatile operating margins fail O'Neil's C-and-A criteria, confirming a lack of institutional-grade fundamentals.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Violates thesis below the 95.68 stop loss; cut immediately to protect capital if selling accelerates below the 50-day moving average.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Displays a constructive Stage 2 structure holding well above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Price is consolidating within 1.5% of the 933.53 pivot on 2.31x volume with an RSI of 54, demonstrating steady accumulation and resilient relative strength during index distribution.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue expanded 38.7% YoY to ₹535.8 Cr, with net profit leaping 65.4% to ₹76.1 Cr and diluted EPS jumping 65.2%. Operating margins expanded to 25%, bolstered by dominant market share in xanthine derivatives and operational leverage.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis fails on a close below 857.38 pivot support. Strict stop discipline is mandatory given broader market distribution.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Strong Stage 2 advance with moving averages aligned in textbook bullish order. Price tightens within 1.5% of the 464.91 pivot with above-average volume (1.37x) and RSI at 72, showing powerful relative strength and strong upside momentum versus the declining benchmark.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue surged 67.8% YoY to ₹857.5 Cr and net profit rose 79.9% to ₹235.3 Cr, lifting EPS by 71.8%. Operating margins remain remarkable near 86%, though heavy debt from utility solar capital buildouts requires vigilant oversight.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Setup aborts on a breakdown below the 425.12 stop; exit swiftly if price breaches the 21-day EMA.

AEGISLOG.technical: Superb institutional sponsorship and relative strength. The stock completed a double-bottom base breakout near 1,501.70 on massive 2.43x volume, with RSI at 68 and price holding decisively above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Pristine CANSLIM profile: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 37% YoY to ₹2,357 Cr while normalized EBITDA jumped 184% and EPS surged 269% to ₹13.80. Surging LPG distribution volumes, expanding margins (₹7,000+/ton), and low gearing (~0.6x) cement undisputed sector leadership.
AEGISLOG.risk: Breakout thesis fails below the 1,358.19 pivot stop. Execute stop discipline without hesitation if market weakness pulls it under.

AGI.technical: Cleared a 20-day high at 824.82 on 2.0x volume, staying above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 60. However, the move is vulnerable to adverse market breadth and lacks confirmation from accelerating earnings.
AGI.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 14.1% YoY to ₹785.3 Cr and net profit rose 11.8% to ₹99.4 Cr (EPS +11.9%). While ROCE is respectable at ~18.4%, EPS growth decelerated from Q4's +61%, failing strict CANSLIM C+A standards.
AGI.risk: Thesis invalidates below the 752.56 stop. Exit promptly if price closes back inside the prior 20-day range.

AHCL.technical: Classic SEPA breakout printing fresh 52-week highs at 27.51 on 1.78x volume expansion. Stacked moving averages confirm powerful Stage 2 momentum and exceptional relative strength, though low absolute price demands strict position sizing.
AHCL.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue leapt 162.9% YoY to ₹87.6 Cr with net profit climbing 87.6% to ₹8.3 Cr (EPS +44.4%), driven by API commercialization and CDMO scale. ROCE is strong at 20.8%, though elevated debtor days (220 days) remain a working-capital headwind.
AHCL.risk: Violates breakout structure below 23.93. Cut losses quickly to guard against high microcap volatility.
